text:
Back at the dojo, you were merely an eyesore—
an obstruction blocking the spotlight I so
rightfully deserved.\c
Yet reaching this pinnacle alongside you fills me
with a certain unexpected pride.[VAR 0114(0072)]
With your raw skill combined with my prodigious\npsychic powers, the idea that anyone should ever\r\nbe able to defeat us is positively unimaginable![VAR 0114(0072)]

Ahaha! You know, I really didn’t like you at first,
kid. But now that we’ve won this thing...\c
I’m actually happy that I did it together
with you![VAR 0114(0071)]

Yes! Did it again!
I can’t get enough of this feeling!\c
All you people watching, hope you like your
double dose of our toxic teamwork![VAR 0114(0071)]

Woo-hoo! Did you see that, [VAR 0100(0000)]?
We won—little old me and you together!\c
I say if you have fun in life, you’ve already won!
And nobody out there can beat us in that![VAR 0114(0073)]

Ahhh, the sweet smell of victory!
Never gets old, does it?\c
Bet you all these big, flashy wins will have new
students swarmin’ to the dojo, too![VAR 0114(0073)]

That’s an ultra-mega-victory for the Peony
Exploration Team on the books!\c
Nothing’s quite as satisfyin’ as firin’ off some
mighty moves, is it, Chief?[VAR 0114(0076)]
Oops! Beat ’em all again, have we?\c\nGahaha! You and me, Chief—we’re just plain\nultra-mega-unstoppable together![VAR 0114(0076)]

Thanks, [VAR 0100(0000)]! That’s just the kind of
fierce battle that gets everyone worked up!\c
I’m proud to have won this thing together with
you, Champion![VAR 0114(0004)]

Typical [VAR 0100(0000)]!
That’s just what I expected of you by now!\c
It always gets me pumped up when I see how you
seem to grow stronger with each battle.\c
Together we’re going to propel all the Trainers in
the Galar region to even greater heights![VAR 0114(0004)]
I suppose a win is a win, though it doesn’t sit very\nwell with me that I have to share this victory\r\nwith you of all people...[VAR 0114(000C)]
This was the only outcome you could have\nexpected with me as your partner, of course.\r\nSo congratulations on choosing wisely.[VAR 0114(000C)]
[VAR 0100(0000)], we did it!\nWe beat every single one of ’em![VAR 0114(000D)]

I knew we could do it! You an’ me are gonna
win all there is to win!\c
Everybody in Galar is gonna know that we’re the
strongest duo around![VAR 0114(000D)]
That’s just like you, [VAR 0100(0000)]!\nAll my Grass-type Pokémon are delighted\r\nwith this first-place win![VAR 0114(000E)]

Well done, [VAR 0100(0000)]!
That’s our Champion!\c
I always feel a bit stronger when I’ve got you at
my side in a battle.[VAR 0114(000E)]

The waves have receded, and only you and I
are left standing...\c
Congratulations on this victory, [VAR 0100(0000)].
And thank you for it.[VAR 0114(000F)]
The raging wave crashes again!\c\nAs long as we’re partnered up, I can’t imagine\nany wave we couldn’t ride together.[VAR 0114(000F)]

A fine performance, [VAR 0100(0000)]!
We’ve claimed victory here together!\c
I could almost combust with joy, and I’m already
looking forward to our next match together![VAR 0114(0010)]

We burned brightly in this latest tournament
as well!\c
I thank you for choosing me to battle beside you
once again, [VAR 0100(0000)]![VAR 0114(0010)]

Hey, winnin’ with you’s not bad.
D’you think the crowd wants an encore?\c
I wouldn’t mind makin’ an exception to
my rule, just this once.[VAR 0114(0016)]

So we won again?
I mean, sure, that’s real nice and all. I’m happy.\c
But I’ve had my time as a Gym Leader already.
Winnin’ too much now would be overkill, innit?[VAR 0114(0016)]

That was a great victory. Just right for keeping up
my image as the great Raihan!\c
Now, time for one great selfie to capture it!
Smile already, [VAR 0100(0000)]![VAR 0114(0017)]

When you put the greatest Trainers together,
the only thing they can’t do is lose!\c
At this rate, we might just end up making history.
Come on, [VAR 0100(0000)]! Strike a pose!\c
We’ve got to capture this moment for the future![VAR 0114(0017)]

We did it...
We have won the tournament!\c
I can stand tall knowing that we were able to
give all that we had together in this fight.[VAR 0114(0011)]

We did it, [VAR 0100(0000)]!
Our breathing was more in sync than ever.\c
If you’d like, we should battle alongside one
another again sometime.[VAR 0114(0011)]
I enjoyed that tournament quite a bit.\c\nThe way that you battled, [VAR 0100(0000)]...\nThat’s what makes you worthy to be my partner.[VAR 0114(0014)]

Nothing surprising about this outcome, when you
consider how strong the two of us are.\c
If you want, I don’t mind continuing to help you
out with racking up these wins.[VAR 0114(0014)]
[VAR 0100(0000)]!\nW...we won!\r\nTh-this is... This is amazing![VAR 0114(0012)]
I...I’m so glad, [VAR 0100(0000)]...\c\nI’d be happy to partner with you...anytime![VAR 0114(0012)]

What a strong performance all around!
This victory was a true team effort.\c
Now, just remember—even if we’re on opposite
sides next time, don’t you hold back one jot![VAR 0114(0015)]
Hee! Looks like we went and won again!\c\nSeems like you might grow rather attached to\nhaving me as a partner if this carries on, hmm?[VAR 0114(0015)]

Quite what I’ve come to expect of you, my liege:
seizing victory even while carrying my weight!\c
Loath as I am to enjoy this thrill without my dear
younger brother...I am delighted from my toes to
the tip of my hair![VAR 0114(0068)]

Well, well, well...
I’m afraid it can no longer slip my notice!\c
The way that you continue to choose me as your
partner in victory...\c
You’ve come to most ardently admire me,
haven’t you, young M[VAR 1100(00FF,0205)]asters. [VAR 0100(0000)]?[VAR 0114(0068)]

How magnificent—seizing victory even while
towing my humble self along for the ride!\c
You, young M[VAR 1100(00FF,0205)]asters. [VAR 0100(0000)], deserve to
be crowned Global Celebrity of the Year![VAR 0114(0069)]

The way that you’ve chosen me to share in your
victories time and again...\c
Young M[VAR 1100(00FF,0205)]asters. [VAR 0100(0000)], are you perhaps
the champion of being too fond of me?\c
Forgive me, Older Brother, but only one of us
can monopolize [VAR 0100(0000)]’s favor—
and it’s me![VAR 0114(0069)]

Being able to beat everyone else together with
my rival [VAR 0100(0000)]...\c
I’m gonna ride this high to really crush my studies
and become a great professor! Just you watch![VAR 0114(0005)]

Getting to win this thing together with you,
[VAR 0100(0000)]—it’s the best every time!\c
And [VAR 0101(0001)] seems to be on cloud nine,
too, getting to battle alongside you!
Heh heh... Thanks for giving us both this chance![VAR 0114(0005)]

Congratulations, young [VAR 1100(00FF,0403)]manlady.\c
Though teaming up with you always makes me
put on a grander show than I’d planned.\c
Still...I have to admit I had fun. You’d think I’d
have outgrown this kind of thing by now!
It seems I’m quite beyond help in that regard.[VAR 0114(0013)]

Congratulations are in order...or are they indeed,
young [VAR 1100(00FF,0403)]manlady?\c
Are you sure this is what you want—sharing the
spotlight of victory with an old crone like me?\c
Oh, you are, are you?\c
Hmph...
Perhaps you’re starting to get a bit pink
yourself, after all...[VAR 0114(0013)]
I offer you my heartfelt congratulations on your\nvictory in the Galarian Star Tournament![VAR 0114(0004)]
I set up this tournament so that Trainers could\nwork together and push each other to greater\r\nheights as they battle...[VAR 0114(0004)]
And it’s turned out to be an even greater success\nthan I ever thought it would be![VAR 0114(0004)]
You were amazing!
Thank you! Both of you!\nOur new Champion and our old one!
All the matches were brilliant!
You hear that? The voices of Galar...\nThe excitement we brought all those people...[VAR 0114(0004)]
They can’t help but be moved by that fantastic\nperformance you two just put on!\r\nTheir hearts are crying out for more![VAR 0114(0004)]
And this glorious tournament that’s brought so\nmuch fire to the people of Galar...\r\nWell, its time is up. We have our clear winners.[VAR 0114(0004)]
Though it’s an awful shame to have to end it,\nafter all the fun it’s been...[VAR 0114(0004)]
Which is why...[VAR 0114(0004)]
I’m pleased to announce that the Galarian Star\nTournament will continue from this day on![VAR 0114(0004)]
Whoaaa! Whaaaat?!
You mean there’ll be more matches?!\nThat’s the best news we’ve had all year!
You can have as many tournaments in this\nMulti Battle format as you can stomach![VAR 0114(0004)]
If you want, you can stick with the same partner\nnext time—or try something different![VAR 0114(0004)]
We’ll get all the strongest Trainers in the Galar\nregion into this wild mix...[VAR 0114(0004)]
And we’ll run wild next time! And the next!\nAnd every time after that![VAR 0114(0004)]
As long as Trainers and Pokémon keep aiming\nfor the top together![VAR 0114(0004)]
As long as our fans want to watch our battles,\ntheir hands sweaty with nerves and excitement![VAR 0114(0004)]
We’ll go on for a thousand years!\nWe’ll carry on forever![VAR 0114(0004)]
So, everyone! Until we next meet![VAR 0114(0004)]
Now let’s have the Maximizers play us off![VAR 0114(0004)]
Shauuu!
Woo-hoo! All right!
